brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided the village of Al-Masara south of Bethlehem on Friday, Shehab Wire reported. Local sources said troops stormed the village and conducted a search of the home of Muhammad Zuwahara, a released and deported prisoner.

The operation marked the latest incursion into areas south of Bethlehem. Forces entered the village without prior warning and proceeded directly to Zuwahara's residence, according to the local accounts. No arrests were reported in connection with the raid.
